hold_reason: The 100/125/150/175/200 % ladder and the mixed-monitor move require an operator to change Windows display settings and to drag a live window between monitors. Those changes are outside this session's authority, so the ladder stays NOT_MEASURED rather than being simulated, and no step is recorded as PASS.

measured_this_round.capture: the identity-proven 96 DPI capture already published at evidence-published/typ1e-host-observe-latest/screenshot.png (sha256 0d44945a…), decoded independently for this record
measured_this_round.method: PNG decoded with the standard library only (IHDR/IDAT, all five scanline filters), colour run lengths read along fixed columns and rows of the 3456x1408 image

dock_ring.colour: rgb(98,104,112) = 0x626870, the structural ring colour (the capture was taken while the Dock held no keyboard focus)
dock_ring.reading: the ring is 2 physical pixels at two sampled columns and 3 at two others; the approved width is 2 DIP and this capture is at scale 1.0, so the 2-pixel samples agree and the 3-pixel samples do not. The anomaly is recorded, not averaged away or explained without evidence.

row_border.reading: one sampled row border is 1 physical pixel, matching the separator contract at scale 1.0

reproduction.note: the capture is a byte-identical copy of the identity-proven one so the run is reproducible from this directory alone
reproduction.verified_run: script ran from this directory against the copied capture and reproduced the 2/2/3/3 px and 1 px readings

the identity-proven capture has no keyboard focus in the Dock; the focused state is only recorded in the earlier computer-use screenshots, which are not identity-proven captures

defects.observation: in one identity-proven 96 DPI capture the dock ring measures 2 physical pixels at x=1200 and x=200 but 3 at x=300 and x=700
defects.why_not_fixed: the sample cannot distinguish a rendering anomaly from a scanline artefact (for example a row border coinciding with the ring); fixing it without that distinction would be a guess, and no contract-approved width other than 2 DIP exists
